home.discardBody: This ends your in-progress game and cannot be undone.

rules.title: How to play
rules.goalBody: Get your team to guess as many words as possible before time runs out — by describing each word without saying it or any part of it.
rules.turnsBody: Split into teams. On your turn one player describes and the rest guess; pass the phone to the next team when the round ends.
rules.actionsBody: Tap Correct when your team gets it, Skip to pass on a tough word, and Foul if the describer says the word itself — fouls can cost points.
rules.timerBody: Every round is timed. When it ends the round stops — or the describer gets one last word, depending on your buzzer setting.
rules.winBody: In Time Score the highest total after every team plays its rounds wins. In Max Score the first team to the target score wins. Ties go to a sudden-death round.

setup.title: New game
setup.duplicateWarning: Two teams share a name — allowed, but they will be hard to tell apart.
setup.finishRotationHint: Let every team complete the round before declaring a winner.
setup.buzzerHardHint: Hard stop: the current word is discarded at zero.
setup.buzzerFinishHint: Finish the word: one last call on the on-screen word after the buzzer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.handednessHint: Mirrors the in-game action buttons for your dominant hand.
settings.appearanceHint: Appearance applies to themes that offer both light and dark (Classic). Arcade and Vivid are dark by design.
